title: Step 1 reads a binding's recipient under the channel's declared key, as stored: a sender a binding names only under the key its channel reads in place of it, on a channel bound to two rooms, is found nowhere and gets a room of their own
notes: The channel declares phone_number and its recipient_address reads reached_at. Both bindings are written through the store with a recipient under reached_at alone and no correspondent. Step 1 finds Bob under neither, and step 3 finds no single room, so Bob gets $r1, though room-bob's binding delivers to him. The ways such a binding is found: routing/a-binding-its-channel-reads-elsewhere-is-found-through-the-correspondent-its-attach-names and routing/a-binding-its-channel-reads-elsewhere-is-found-at-step-three-as-the-one-room.
